acceptance_criteria.description: The diff is confined to the five owned paths and uses existing locked dependencies without manifest or lockfile changes.

A real coop-server binary smoke proves explicit phase2-local startup on a literal loopback ephemeral port with required bootstrap invite/signing configuration, and fails closed for missing or invalid configuration.

Real Axum HTTP routes prove invite registration, case-insensitive login, fenced lease acquisition, generic unauthorized/foreign resume behavior, two-file snapshot prepare/upload/finalize, signed active package verification, reconnect with a strictly higher server epoch, stale fence rejection, release, and revision-preserving reacquire.

The uploaded/resumed synthetic character state contains Hoenn, Kanto, Johto, and Sevii progress with region-qualified trainer and fly identifiers, round-trips exactly, and demonstrates that Kanto cooperative tier ignores Hoenn badge count.

The launcher smoke uses its final injectable lifecycle and an in-process real LocalSidecar to perform control-first authentication, bridge handshake, ROM_READY, CHECKPOINT_READY, grant, CHECKPOINT_GRANTED, synthetic SAV update, SAVE_DATA_UPDATED, upload/finalize, and fenced release without shadow protocol DTOs.
A shell-free standard-library Python runner executes both exact integration targets with bounded timeouts and emits one deterministic machine-readable JSON result.

Operator documentation contains exact local commands, required environment/configuration, secret handling, manual mGBA 0.10.5 Tools-to-Scripting loading, failure recovery, and the limits of the synthetic SAV fixture without overstating production Firebase/PostgreSQL readiness.
Focused smoke targets, the Python runner, workspace tests/clippy, formatting, and diff checks all pass.

closed_decisions: Use the real server binary and real Axum routes for server proof; use deterministic test clocks/entropy/Argon2 cost only inside test construction.
Use the real LocalSidecar and bridge/control codecs for launcher proof, but fake external cloud, keychain, filesystem, mGBA child, and ROM timing at injected boundaries.
The synthetic SAV is an opaque serialized CharacterCloudState test fixture, not a claim about the production Pokémon save-block layout.
Server owns every session epoch; the launcher persists and presents it but never increments or invents it.
Stock mGBA 0.10.5 requires manual Lua loading through Tools to Scripting; do not invent an unsupported script-autoload flag.
Do not require Docker, Firebase, PostgreSQL, external network access, or credentials for this local deterministic slice.
forbidden_changes: Do not edit production Rust/C/Lua code, Cargo manifests, Cargo.lock, migrations, orchestration records, or any file outside ownership.
Do not add dependencies, duplicate protocol encoders/CRC/signature logic in Python, weaken authentication/fencing/signature checks, or expose secrets in output.
Do not use shell=True, unbounded waits, remote services, wildcard binds, network publication, Git staging/commits, push, deployment, or release operations.
Do not claim stock mGBA Lua autoload, real-ROM SAV layout interoperability, or production persistence readiness when only deterministic local adapters are exercised.
objective: Prove one runnable local Phase 2 cloud-coop checkpoint lifecycle across the real server HTTP surface, launcher orchestration, sidecar control channel, and regional cloud state, with bounded repeatable tooling and operator documentation.

return_when: Every acceptance criterion is resolved and every required verification command has a recorded outcome.
A public server, launcher, or sidecar API required by the smoke is unavailable and would require an unowned production edit.
A concrete platform/tooling blocker prevents the bounded local smoke from running within the owned files and budget.
